about_the_game:
Listen to the dulcet tones of Hell in this original soundtrack to Summerfall Studios' Malys. Spanning the music of the Lower Stacks to the Inner Core and beyond, join Noah on his journey to Expose, Endure and Expel evil from the innocent.

From gifted Melbourne composer Belinda Coomes and featuring the incredible Montaigne, the soundtrack to Malys is a must-have for anyone who enjoys a good voyage through the dark night of the soul.

content_descriptors.notes:
Malys has themes that could be confronting, unnerving, or a little scary for some players. Most of the unnerving content in Malys is in written content that can be skipped at any time, but there are some visual depictions that may unsettle some people. Malys is not overtly gory or violent, but does have unnerving themes and undertones of horror. Think Supernatural, not Hereditary!

- Demonic Imagery and Themes
Characters with demonic visuals, themes, intent, and narrative context feature heavily in Malys.

- Language
Occasionally, there is the use of crude language and minor profanity.

- Smoking
There is content regarding smoking in game.

- Alcohol Use
Written descriptions of characters drinking alcohol feature in certain scenes.

- Death
Mentions of death, dying, or deceased individuals, as well as ghosts.

- Children in Peril
Text and visual depictions of children who are possessed or under threat of possession and therefore in danger of death.

- Graphic Descriptions
Written descriptions that are horror themed, harrowing, or could be unsettling to the reader.

- Suicide
Content related to suicide is present in the game.
